## Trash removal

Shiny widget defined in 'Viz/check_trajectories.r' draws raw trajectories for each participant.

From this, it was determined to remove:
- P 23, 24, 17, 36, & 52, wholesale, for messy, rotated, trajectories
- Trajectories where P's 20 & 37 reached backwards for some reason

```{r}
# Threshold of 50 mm forward motion would work to flag "reverse" reaches
local({
  drop_these <- dt[
    frame %between% c(0, 50),
    .(m = mean(hand_z)),
    .(participant, trajectory)
  ][
    m < -50
  ]$trajectory

  dt <<- droplevels(dt[!trajectory %in% drop_these])
  dt <<- droplevels(dt[!(participant %in% c("23", "24", "17", "36", "52"))])
})
```

## Label movement bounds 

Movement start/stop demarcated by velocity threshold, following procedure detailed in Gallivan & Chapman 2015.

Start defined as the first four consecutive samples wherein reach velocity exceeds 20 mm/s and is accelerating.

Stop works in the opposite. After a minimum distance of 30 cm (forward motion), stop is the first four samples wherein movement criteria are not met.

#### Find start

```{r}
local({
  movement_bounds <- dt[,
    .(velocity, acceleration),
    keyby = .(participant, block_num, trial_num, frame)
  ] |>
    _[,
      .(
        frame,
        acceleration,
        runs = frollsum(
          velocity >= 20,
          n = 4,
          align = "right",
          na.rm = TRUE
        )
      ),
      keyby = .(participant, block_num, trial_num)
    ] |>
    _[
      # Instances were thresholds are met
      runs >= 4 & acceleration >= 20,
      # Subset and grab first frame
      .(start_frame = .SD[1, frame]),
      keyby = .(participant, block_num, trial_num)
    ]

  dt <<- dt[
    movement_bounds,
    on = .(participant, block_num, trial_num),
    start_frame := i.start_frame
  ]
})
```

#### Find end

```{r}
summary(dt[, max(hand_z), trajectory]$V1)
hist(dt[, max(hand_z), trajectory]$V1)
```

Visual inspection revealed some jitter. Smoothing z-pos slightly, then finding first instance of the max.

```{r}
dt[, apex_idx :=
  which.max(
    frollmean(
      hand_z, 5,
      align = "center", na.rm = TRUE
    )
  ),
by = .(trajectory)
]

summary(dt[frame == apex_idx, hand_z, trajectory]$hand_z)
hist(dt[frame == apex_idx, hand_z, trajectory]$hand_z)
```

Objects were ~30cm from starting position, but due to a variety of human factors, could vary in placement. Additionally, varying hand sizes could introduce noise.

With that in mind, will allow some wiggle room. 25cm seems a reasonable cutoff.


```{r}
dt <- dt[, .SD[frame <= apex_idx], trajectory][, apex_idx := NULL]

# only ~ 6%
mean(dt[, max(hand_z), trajectory]$V1 <= 250)

local({
  toss <- dt[, max(hand_z), trajectory][V1 < 250]$trajectory
  dt <<- droplevels(dt[!trajectory %in% toss])
})
```
